title: G4 Delta Track
style: Drift phonk with cinematic spy-fi tension at 144 BPM, hard swing and heavy 808 bounce; verse rides tense rap over cowbells, acid leads, and siren stabs; pre-chorus strips to bass pulse and filtered gang vocals; chorus hits with powerful sung hooks and shout doubles. Backing ad-libs punch key words, tire-screech risers snap into drops, reversed swells bridge transitions, bright aggressive mix with a glossy Hollywood chase feel., soundtrack, strong, natural, theme, stylized, steady, hollywood, world, rap
lyrics:
[Intro]
Spy break got the data now, run, run, run
Go, go, go
Safe and sound
Unit forty-eight, all good

[Verse 1]
Acid adrenaline, heart on ten
Conductor mind, I map the bends
Angles on angles, I read the lane
One clean line through the falling rain
Guard got up, I cut that spin
Mirror eyes, I fold it in
Hands stay steady, wheels stay cold
Every move calculated, every turn controlled

[Pre-Chorus]
Watch the numbers climb
Watch the distance shrink
One wrong choice
And the whole thing sinks
But I see the path
Clear as a sign
Maths Driver rolling
Right on time

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive it home, drive it home
Safe and sound
Everyone home
Everyone home
Safe and sound

[Verse 2]
Watch out, black truck, I slide and switch
No panic, just precision in the pitch
Big tires scream, but I never drift blind
I break the lock with a cleaner line
Sirens blare, I let them talk
Take the corner like a chessboard walk
No bacon left, no body in sight
Just one more gap and the edge of night

[Pre-Chorus]
Guardrails fade
Then the screen goes green
I count the odds
Like a machine
One deep breath
Then I cross that line
Maths Driver moving
Right on time

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive it home, drive it home
Safe and sound
Everyone home
Everyone home
Safe and sound

[Bridge]
Bumble bee bytes in the bloodstream
Data paths flying through the dream
G4 delta, legendary road
Every risk gets split, every fear gets coded
Three mirrors, I see the next three moves
Reverse the vector, find the groove
Panthera pounce on the final bend
Then we roll in clean at the very end

[Verse 3]
Decimal degrees, I know the way
Probability bends when I say okay
Viral stunt, but the crew stays green
Mission complete in a flashing screen
Spy break done, the vault goes dim
Every heartbeat syncs to the rim
From the first sharp turn to the last long climb
I wrote the route in the math of time

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive it home, drive it home
Safe and sound
Everyone home
Everyone home
Safe and sound

[Outro]
Driver got us home
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
